This fruit was last seen in the possession of a notorious pirate captain who sailed the Grand Line over a century ago. Legends say that whoever possesses this fruit will become almost invincible in battle as they can slow down even the fastest of opponents, making it nearly impossible to land a hit.

cardPool.value: The Clone Clone Fruit is a rare devil fruit that allows the user to create duplicates of themselves. Each clone possesses the same abilities, memories, and personality as the user, making them indistinguishable from the original. However, the user can only create a limited number of clones at one time, and if any clone is destroyed, it will disappear and cause damage to the user's body. The origins of this devil fruit are unknown, but it is said to have been possessed by a powerful pirate who used its ability to deceive and outwit his enemies.

cardPool.value: A rare and powerful Devil Fruit that transforms the user into a fearsome reaper. The Scythe-Scythe fruit grants the user the ability to generate razor-sharp scythe blades from their body, which they can wield with deadly precision. These blades can be used in a variety of ways, from slicing through enemies to cutting through objects and barriers. However, the downside of this power is that it drains the user's energy quickly, making prolonged battles difficult. Additionally, the user's body becomes more vulnerable when the blades are not in use, which forces them to strike fast and hard to avoid taking damage.

The user is able to transport themselves and others to different locations instantaneously, as well as create portals through solid surfaces. Those who consume this fruit are warned of the potential dangers of losing track of which way is up, down, left, or right, as well as the difficulty in controlling the size and shape of created openings.

cardPool.title: Spring Spring fruit
cardPool.value: The Spring Spring fruit is a paramecia-type devil fruit that grants the user the ability to manipulate the properties of springs. The user can stretch their body, limbs and even objects they touch storing potential energy while contracting and then launching themselves or others forward. This devil fruit is particularly sought after by acrobatic fighters and tricksters, who use their newfound nimbleness to outmaneuver enemies.

Regardless of their methods, pirates are always on the lookout for treasure, adventure, and the chance to make a name for themselves.

cardPool.value: Beli is the currency used in the world of One Piece. This versatile currency can be used to purchase almost anything, from weapons and food to ships and crew members. Beli can be earned through various means, such as completing quests, selling loot, or winning competitions. As you progress in your adventure, you will need to accumulate vast sums of Beli to purchase powerful equipment, hire skilled crew members, and upgrade your ship. Keep a keen eye on your finances and spend wisely, as mismanagement can lead to dire consequences in this ruthless world.

Promotions through the ranks are earned based on merit and achievements, but corruption and politics within the Marine hierarchy can also play a role. cardPool.value: The Shadow Shadow fruit is one of the rarest and most sought-after Devil Fruits in the One Piece world. When consumed, it grants the user the ability to manipulate shadows - their own, others', and even those of inanimate objects. This allows the user to move through darkness unseen, create shadow clones, and even bring inanimate shadows to life as independent entities. One legendary user of the Shadow Shadow fruit was the infamous pirate captain, Gecko Moria, who used its power to create a massive army of undead soldiers.

When the user consumes the fruit, they gain the ability to generate and manipulate mirrors at will, including being able to create portals between them. When reflected in one of the user's mirrors, any physical attack or object can be redirected to a different location of the user's choosing, making it an incredibly versatile and powerful ability. However, if the user is knocked unconscious or killed, their mirrors will shatter, leaving them vulnerable.

However, this ability comes at the cost of an inability to swim, as the user's body becomes heavy and sinkable in water. Its current whereabouts are unknown, but it is rumored to be in the possession of a fiery pirate captain.

The true potential of this fruit is unlocked when it is used to perform the 'Eternal Youth' surgery, which grants everlasting life to the recipient. This fruit was famously wielded by the notorious pirate surgeon Trafalgar Law.

cardPool.title: Calm-Calm fruit

This fruit is highly prized by pirates and marines alike for its unique power, and its ultimate fate remains shrouded in mystery.

The Flame Flame Fruit is highly coveted by pirates and marines alike due to its ability to cause widespread destruction and chaos on a massive scale.

cardPool.title: Sand Sand fruit
cardPool.value: A rare and mysterious Devil Fruit that was once wielded by a powerful pirate. Consuming this fruit grants the user the ability to turn their own body into sand at will. This allows the user to phase through solid objects, disintegrate attacks and even manipulate the surrounding sand to create deadly sandstorms. However, the user becomes vulnerable to water-based attacks and loses their power when submerged in water.

cardPool.title: Ice Ice Fruit
cardPool.value: The Ice Ice Fruit is a rare devil fruit that grants the user the power to control and create ice. The user gains the ability to freeze objects and create structures made of ice through their hands or breath.

cardPool.title: Swamp Swamp Fruit
cardPool.value: The **Swamp-Swamp Fruit** (Numa Numa no Mi) is a Logia-type Devil Fruit in the *One Piece* series. It was eaten by Caribou. This fruit allows the user to create, control, and become a swamp. The user can trap people and objects in the swamp they generate, effectively imprisoning them within their body. As a Logia user, Caribou can also transform his body into swamp to avoid attacks, rendering them intangible and giving him a significant defensive advantage. Additionally, he can store an enormous amount of items and people within his swampy body, making it a versatile tool for both combat and utility.

cardPool.title: Gas Gas fruit
cardPool.value: This rare and mysterious fruit grants the user the ability to manipulate and transform their body into different forms of gas. They can become a deadly poison, a thick smokescreen, or even explosive gas at will. The gas can be controlled with extreme precision, allowing manipulation of its density, velocity, and direction. However, the user becomes vulnerable to physical attacks while in gaseous form, requiring skill and strategy to utilize this power effectively in combat.

cardPool.title: Buccaneer
cardPool.value:
The Buccaneer race in One Piece is a nearly extinct race of humanoids taller than average humans but smaller than giants. According to One Piece chapter 1095, the backstory of Kuma and his ties to the Buccaneer race were revealed. The Buccaneers race is said to have existed in the One Piece world long ago.

They were a powerful and ancient race allied with the Ancient Kingdom. The Buccaneer race consists of people with giant's blood running through their veins, which makes them absolutely massive and ensures that they possess tremendous amounts of strength.

cardPool.title: Brawler/Devil Fruit User
cardPool.value: Brawlers are combatants who rely on physical strength and hand-to-hand combat skills to overcome their foes. Devil Fruit users, on the other hand, possess unique abilities granted by consuming a Devil Fruit, allowing them to manipulate elements, transform their body, or exert extraordinary powers. Combining these two classes can create formidable fighters capable of unleashing devastating attacks in close combat.

cardPool.title: Swordsman/Devil Fruit User
cardPool.value: The Swordsman/Devil Fruit User is a unique class that merges the art of swordsmanship with the extraordinary powers granted by consuming a Devil Fruit. Members of this class are capable of wielding blades with unparalleled skill, combined with the ability to harness the formidable abilities of the Devil Fruit. Their combat prowess and versatility make them highly sought-after allies and formidable adversaries in the world of One Piece.
